body: What highlight group names do you see in the thousands of lines?

Lunarvim have it too, and they solved the issue
https://github.com/LunarVim/LunarVim/issues/1880
https://github.com/LunarVim/LunarVim/pull/1934

Sorry if this has not been clear, I see no highlight group names. The above example is a snippet from the full output of `:hi`. To make the above output more clear, here is another excerpt from the output of `:hi`:
```
SignifySignDeleteFirstLine xxx links to SignifySignDelete
SignifySignChange xxx links to DiffChange
SignifySignChangeDelete xxx links to SignifySignChange
               xxx cleared
               xxx cleared
               xxx cleared
               xxx cleared
```
Seems to be related to signs.
Maybe, but I am nor sure about this. I see the very same error also with other plugin that induce many highlighting groups.
The bugs reference by @maxxnino seem very much related! Thanks for referencing them!

Minimal repro vimrc:
```vim
function! Repro()
  sign define ReproSign text=R texthl=Operator linehl=Operator
  sign define ReproSign text=R texthl=Operator linehl=
endfunction

nnoremap <Space> <Cmd>call Repro()<CR>
```

Run `nvim --clean -u` with this file, hold down space bar, and there will be a lot of these in output of `:hi`:
```
           xxx cleared
           xxx cleared
           xxx cleared
           xxx cleared
           xxx cleared
```

This is indeed a problem introduced in a9f563a, but I think this problem is a manifestation of an upstream problem where highlight groups with empty strings in their names are created. I created a vim/vim#9280 about it. If this is not fixed upstream, the following condition needs to be modified to `if (len > 200) {`.

https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/1e6eeca9d1360554ee18525603e83c3a1999a622/src/nvim/syntax.c#L7628

Bram chose to make empty highlight group with `:sign` fail in <https://github.com/vim/vim/commit/5e18ccc60bdddc4aa39ab039f1a7c918f29e67ce>.
If that patch is ported, I guess vim-signify will completely stop working?

> Bram chose to make empty highlight group with `:sign` fail in [vim/vim@5e18ccc](https://github.com/vim/vim/commit/5e18ccc60bdddc4aa39ab039f1a7c918f29e67ce).

That's been reverted now.

> If this is not fixed upstream, the following condition needs to be modified to `if (len > 200) {`.

I think that's the right fix.

>>Bram chose to make empty highlight group with :sign fail in vim/vim@5e18ccc.
>
>That's been reverted now. 

vim/vim@e5710a0 only partially reverts vim/vim@5e18ccc. Therefore, this issue is resolved by #16541.
The same problem occurs with name highlight groups that are longer than the buffer of `syn_name2id`(`syn_name2id_len`). For this reason I created vim/vim#9289.

issue.title: vim-patch:8.2.3664,8.2.3743,8.2.3747,8.2.3748,8.2.3757

repository.name: neovim
repository.description: Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability

issue.body:
#### vim-patch:8.2.3664: cannot adjust sign highlighting for 'cursorline'

Problem:    Cannot adjust sign highlighting for 'cursorline'.
Solution:   Add CursorLineSign and CursorLineFold highlight groups.
            (Gregory Anders, closes vim/vim#9201)
https://github.com/vim/vim/commit/e413ea04b716effb28eb49dbc98ad3f9f761545a


#### vim-patch:8.2.3743: ":sign" can add a highlight group without a name

Problem:    ":sign" can add a highlight group without a name.
Solution:   Give an error if the group name is missing. (closes vim/vim#9280)
https://github.com/vim/vim/commit/5e18ccc60bdddc4aa39ab039f1a7c918f29e67ce


#### vim-patch:8.2.3747: cannot remove highlight from an existing sign

Problem:    Cannot remove highlight from an existing sign. (James McCoy)
Solution:   Only reject empty argument for a new sign.
https://github.com/vim/vim/commit/0bac5fc5e125b7aa0f3b596c9b7f4381279e6688


#### vim-patch:8.2.3748: giving an error for an empty sign argument breaks a plugin

Problem:    Giving an error for an empty sign argument breaks a plugin.
Solution:   Do not give an error.
https://github.com/vim/vim/commit/e5710a02cb78c2a0a868ea55740835c78ddecbb4


#### vim-patch:partial 6304be625ce4

Update runtime files.
https://github.com/vim/vim/commit/6304be625ce44dcfedc6735164d0b853578581c8

Remaining changes left out of 03d250eb4504d5168a754d0f3b7e9992337d60b4

#### vim-patch:8.2.3757: an overlong highlight group name is silently truncated

Problem:    An overlong highlight group name is silently truncated.
Solution:   Give an error if the name is too long. (closes vim/vim#9289)
https://github.com/vim/vim/commit/f7f7aaf8aaad34a38d3f159e031c5bcf3394f8f1

---
Closes #16494
